findings.message: Dynamic command passed to system() or popen() (CWE-78). Invoking a shell with non-literal input may allow OS command injection. Prefer execv/execvp with explicit argument arrays and strict input allowlists.

Unchecked integer multiplication inside heap allocation (CWE-190 / CWE-680). Multiplication overflow can cause under-allocation followed by heap buffer overflow. Validate multiplication bounds or use calloc(count, elem_size).
